title: Forms and Input Elements
description: Learn to create forms with various input types including text fields, textareas, select dropdowns, radio buttons, checkboxes, and submit buttons.

quiz.question: Which tag is used to create a form in HTML?
quiz.explanation: The `<form>` tag wraps all form elements.

quiz.question: What attribute of the <form> tag specifies where to send form data on submission?
quiz.explanation: The `action` attribute defines the URL to which the form data is sent.

quiz.question: Which input type creates a multi-line text box?
Which input type creates a dropdown list?
What attribute groups radio buttons so only one can be selected at a time?
quiz.explanation: Radio buttons with the same `name` attribute belong to one group.

quiz.question: Which input type creates a checkbox?
How do you create a submit button in a form?
quiz.explanation: You can use `<button>` or `<input type='submit'>` for submitting forms.

quiz.question: Which attribute specifies the placeholder text inside an input field?
quiz.explanation: The `placeholder` attribute shows hint text inside inputs.

quiz.question: What attribute is used to disable a form input?
quiz.explanation: The `disabled` attribute makes the input uneditable and excluded from submission.

quiz.question: Which tag is used to associate text labels with form inputs?
quiz.explanation: The `<label>` tag improves accessibility by linking labels to inputs.
